source.title: US Military had close call after using AI for hallucinated intelligence report
source.author: realsarm

title.zh: 军事AI情报误报险酿冲突
title.en: Military AI Intelligence Nearly Triggered a Crisis

excerpt.zh: 军事AI情报曾将中国船只货物误判为核武器项目部件，并一度推动拦截准备，暴露战时生成式AI核验不足的风险。
excerpt.en: Military AI intelligence reportedly misidentified cargo on a Chinese ship, nearly prompting an operation and exposing weak verification in wartime AI use.

text.zh: 军事AI情报如何制造误判
text.en: How Military AI Intelligence Produced a False Lead

text.zh: 军事AI情报在一次涉及中国船只的事件中暴露出高风险。根据CNN援引的消息人士，战争期间，一份在美国军方内部流传的情报报告称，一艘中国船只正在中东运输核武器项目相关部件；军方因此准备拦截，武装人员可能准备登船，军机也已升空。
text.en: Military AI intelligence came under scrutiny after a high-risk incident involving a Chinese ship. According to sources cited by CNN, an intelligence report circulated during the war with Iran claimed that the vessel was carrying components linked to a nuclear weapons program in the Middle East. The U.S. military moved toward an interception: armed personnel were reportedly preparing to board, and military aircraft were in the air.

text.zh: 官员在行动前进一步核查后发现，这份报告由一名特种作战司令部分析人员借助聊天机器人生成。聊天机器人错误识别了船上货物，随后又被用于把结论整理成标准情报报告。报道说，这份报告完全错误，而其传播距离实际行动已经很近；对中国船只采取行动也可能使局势升级为两国军事冲突。
text.en: Officials examined the report more closely before the planned operation and found that a special operations analyst had used a chatbot to produce it. The chatbot incorrectly identified the cargo, and AI was then used again to format the conclusion as a standard intelligence report. Sources described the report as entirely false and said the incident came close to triggering an operation that could have escalated into a conflict between the United States and China.
AI Hallucinations Meet the Speed of Military Decisions

text.zh: 事件的关键并不只是模型会产生幻觉，而是错误内容进入了一个本身具有权威外观的决策流程。该工具据称融合了公开信息与政府持有的机密信号情报，但来源没有说明使用的是商业聊天机器人还是政府产品。美国军方正推动AI用于情报分析、目标选择、后勤和供应链管理，速度优势是其加速部署的重要理由。
text.en: The central problem was not simply that a model hallucinated. An unverified output entered a workflow whose formal appearance could make it seem authoritative. The tool reportedly combined open-source material with classified signals intelligence, although the sources did not establish whether it was a commercial chatbot or a government system. U.S. officials are promoting AI for intelligence analysis, targeting, logistics, and supply chains because faster decisions are seen as strategically important.

text.zh: 报道同时指出，不同政府部门使用的系统、命令和安全标准并不统一，也没有一套适用于所有工具的验证规范。即使有人在流程中保留“人在回路”，如果人员受到快速产出压力、过度信任系统，或缺乏独立证据核对，人工监督仍可能无法阻止致命误判。
text.en: CNN also reported that different parts of the government use different tools, directives, and safety practices, with no single verification standard. A human reviewer may not be enough if analysts face pressure to produce quickly, trust fluent outputs, or lack independent evidence with which to challenge them. That is especially consequential when AI is used in targeting, where an information error can become a physical action.

text.zh: 真正的开放问题是验证机制
这起事件不能证明所有军事AI都会导致冲突，也不能说明报道中未披露的具体系统具有普遍代表性。但它清楚显示，目标识别和战场决策需要比普通办公场景更高的可追溯性、来源分级和独立复核。美国军方如何统一工具标准、记录模型参与过程，并确保分析人员不会把流畅的输出当成事实，将决定AI究竟是提高判断效率，还是让错误更快进入行动链条。
text.en: The episode does not establish that all military AI systems behave this way, and the specific undisclosed tool cannot represent every deployment. It does show why targeting and battlefield decisions require stronger traceability, source grading, and independent review than ordinary administrative uses. Whether the U.S. military can standardize tools, record how models influenced an assessment, and prevent analysts from treating fluent output as fact will determine whether AI improves judgment or accelerates mistakes into the operational chain.

text.zh: 更现实的短期风险不是机器脱离控制，而是人类依据未经充分验证的自动化结论采取行动。对军事AI而言，降低这种风险需要明确的禁止场景、分级授权和可审计的人工核验；仅仅把最终按钮交给人，并不足以证明决策已经安全。
text.en: The more immediate risk is not necessarily a machine escaping human control. It is people acting on automated conclusions that have not been adequately checked. For military AI, reducing that risk requires explicit no-go uses, tiered authorization, and auditable human verification. Keeping a person at the final approval point alone does not demonstrate that the decision process is safe.
